content_sections.heading: About DLSA
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Krishna is located at Machilipatnam, and its Chairperson is the Principal District Judge. This recruitment follows guidelines of the Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority issued under ROC No.169-SO/APSLSA/LSW/2026, dated 14 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Driver Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed 18 years and must not have crossed 44 years as on 1 September 2026, subject to the applicable rules. Must have passed SSC examination. Must possess a valid Heavy Motor Cycle (HMV) Driving License. Priority will be given to candidates who worked in the Courts/Legal Services Authority earlier. The candidate must be of sound health and active habits, and free from any bodily defect or infirmity that would make him or her unfit for the service. The candidate's character and antecedents must be such as would not disqualify him or her for the service. Employees who were dismissed, removed, compulsorily retired or made to seek retirement are not eligible for re-employment. Candidates resorting to bring influence of any kind will be disqualified summarily. The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble A.P. State Legal Services Authority.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and on wages basis. Service is liable to be terminated at any time without assigning any reasons and without any notice. Appointed candidates shall discharge their duties sincerely, courteously and honestly to the satisfaction of the Presiding Officers.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Driver Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take the application proforma appended to the notification. Applications in any other format will be summarily rejected. Fill in your name in block letters, father's name, date of birth and age as on 1 September 2026, mobile number, both addresses and category. Add your education, technical and other qualifications, driving license details with license number and validity date, any other relevant information and previous experience, then sign and enter the place and date. Affix the attested photograph in the place specified and attach the documents listed below. Write the name of the post applied for on the envelope cover. Send the application to: The Chairperson, District Legal Services Authority, Krishna District at Machilipatnam. Attested copies of academic and technical qualification certificates, such as marks lists, pass certificates, provisional certificates, testimonials and the Driving License, along with other certificates proving professional skills, if any. Certificate evidencing date of birth. Latest community certificate issued by the Competent Revenue Authority, for BC, SC and ST candidates. Any other relevant certificates. A self addressed cover duly stamped with Rs.65/- for registered post with acknowledgment. One recent passport size photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer. Applications with insufficient information will be summarily rejected. Applications without the necessary enclosures will be rejected. Applications received before the notification or after the closing time will not be entertained. The office is not responsible for any postal or courier delay, and no correspondence will be entertained on this. No T.A. or D.A. will be paid for the journey performed in connection with the recruitment. The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the notification without assigning any reasons.

faq.question: Q1. Which driving license is required for the DLSA Krishna Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a valid Heavy Motor Cycle (HMV) Driving License. The application form also asks for the license number and its validity date.

faq.question: Q2. How much can the Driver earn in a month?
faq.answer: The wage is paid per working day at Rs.800/-, and monthly earnings cannot go above the ceiling of Rs.23,780/-.

faq.question: Q3. Does earlier court experience help?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who worked in the Courts or a Legal Services Authority earlier will get priority, and the form has a row for previous experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for an SC, ST, BC or EWS candidate?
faq.answer: The limit of 44 years is relaxed by five years for these candidates, subject to the applicable rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and on wages basis, and the service can be ended at any time without notice.

faq.question: Q6. Why is a stamped cover needed with the application?
faq.answer: The notice requires a self addressed cover stamped with Rs.65/- for registered post with acknowledgment. Leaving out a required enclosure can lead to rejection.

faq.question: Q7. Who should attest the photograph?
faq.answer: A Gazetted Officer must attest one recent passport size photograph, which is fixed at the top of the application.

faq.question: Q8. What happens if the application is delayed by post?
faq.answer: The office takes no responsibility for postal or courier delay, so an application arriving after 5.00 PM on the last date will not be entertained.
